title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
source: SBD > ? > DAT > CD; CD > Sound Forge 10 > flac; Upgrade to existing source SBD 19903

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard remaster of a solid June 1973 show, highlighted by an epic Eyes > Stella jam and a rare one‑drummer Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The remastered tape offers excellent stereo imaging and crisp instrument separation, with Phil’s bass described as warm and the overall mix clean. Musically the performance is tight and energetic – the Eyes > Stella sequence shines with an extended outro jam, and a rare one‑drummer Black Peter adds a special treat – though reviewers note it isn’t an earth‑shattering show for the year. Minor tape dropout at the end of Dark Star is the only blemish mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently praise a clear, well‑balanced recording and solid musical performance with standout moments, offset by a few minor critiques; overall rating falls in the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and clean soundboard capture with good stereo image and instrument presence; a tiny dropout at the end of Dark Star is noted but does not significantly affect listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly with clean playing and steady energy; the middle of Set 1 feels especially nice, highlighted by a rare one‑drummer Black Peter, while the Eyes > Stella jam provides the show’s peak moment.

band_member_comments.Phil: Described as 'nice and warm' on bass.
band_member_comments.Drums: A rare one‑drummer Black Peter performance is singled out as a fine highlight.
